title: Not as pretty irl
text: Not as pretty irl. I wanted baskets with non plastic woven in them and these looked super cute on the add. When I opened them tho they were just 🫤 meh. Laughably simple, clunky, rustic. And the patterns lacked definition. They each have a small woven hanging loop in the back. They are very thick.

product_metadata.title: Brea & Co. Natural Woven Wall Basket Décor - No Plastic, Wicker Farmhouse Boho Wall Decor Style, 3 Handmade Artisan Wall Baskets, Nursery Wall Art, Decorative Bowls Gift
features: ALL NATURAL - Our baskets are made from 100% natural materials and are eco-friendly. No plastics or unnatural materials are used in any of the baskets.

UNIQUELY HANDMADE - All of our baskets are individually woven by hand so that no two are exactly the same. There will be slight variations in the knitted patterns and natural dyes per basket. Each one has its own unique characteristics so that you will always have something that no one else does.
DIMENSIONS - This exclusive set comes with 3 wall baskets in the sizes: 13.8" (35 cm) X 1.5" (4 cm), 11.8" (30 cm) X 1.5" (4 cm), and 9.8 (25 cm) X 1.2" (3 cm)
BOHO STYLE - Our hanging baskets add a bohemian charm to any room that they are in! These exotic pieces of art are sure to bring a natural element to your home.
EASY TO HANG - All 3 baskets come with hoops on the backside of them for easy setup. Just simply hang the baskets by their hoops on your wall and customize your space in an artistic way.
